assets.name: Don Tremendous
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: final standalone square portrait for Cancel City card game. Create NEW illustration; reference image is style guidance only. Match its grotesque punk underground comic art: thick energetic black ink outlines, dense scratchy crosshatching, textured cheap paper, distressed vivid screen-printed colours, exaggerated confrontational face, detailed hand-drawn anatomy. Square full-bleed chest-up or tight waist-up composition, head dominates frame, instantly legible at thumbnail size. No card frame, border, UI, titles, readable lettering, logos or watermark. Rich detailed background with symbolic props. High resolution at least 1024 square. Subject: An unmistakably Donald Trump-inspired grotesque political cartoon, huge orange face, aggressively swooping pale blond comb-over, squinting eyes, pursed shouting mouth, oversized navy suit and absurdly long bright red necktie. Standing behind a ludicrous gold podium with both tiny hands performing emphatic pinching gestures. Gold-red fireworks and abstract television-camera silhouettes, no readable slogans, no logos or flags.
inspection_notes: Inspected rendered output against CC026 reference: thick scratchy black ink, vivid distressed red/gold/navy palette, paper grain, full-bleed square composition.
Exaggerated orange face and pale blond sweep dominate frame; navy suit, long red tie, two pinching hand gestures, gold podium, camera silhouettes and fireworks all present.
No readable text, card frame, watermark or identifiable brand logo. Political satire is clearly a drawn comic, not a realistic photograph.
